title.en: Fireworks separates two security incidents in updated disclosure
title.zhHans: Fireworks 更新通报，将安全事件区分为两起

searchSummary.en: Fireworks updated its security bulletin on November 17, separating August–October and late-October intrusions and saying account and billing data for all accounts opened before October 30 was accessed.
searchSummary.zhHans: Fireworks 于 11 月 17 日更新安全通报，将八月至十月初与十月下旬的入侵区分为两起，并称 10 月 30 日前创建的所有账户的账户及账单资料被访问。

summary.en: On November 17, Fireworks updated its security bulletin, separating August–October and late-October intrusions and saying account and billing data for all accounts opened before October 30 was accessed.
summary.zhHans: 11 月 17 日，Fireworks 更新安全通报，将八月至十月初与十月下旬的入侵区分为两起，并称 10 月 30 日前创建的所有账户的账户及账单资料被访问。

narrative.en: Fireworks says the first incident ran August 3–October 7 and its Unit 42 investigation is complete; it says a separate October 23–30 intrusion reached production systems and remains under AprosSyber investigation. Its November 9 interim bulletin reported disabled self-service dataset transfers; that is not the date of the latest update. Separately, Notion says data was retained on Fireworks endpoints it used despite its zero-retention contract, and that some unattributable Notion AI chats may have been exposed. Neither account independently verifies the other party’s full incident scope.
narrative.zhHans: Fireworks 称，第一起事件持续于 8 月 3 日至 10 月 7 日，Unit 42 对该事件的调查已完成；另一起 10 月 23 日至 30 日的入侵触及生产系统，AprosSyber 仍在调查。11 月 9 日的中期通报曾称暂停自助数据集传输，但那不是最新更新日期。另据 Notion 称，其使用的 Fireworks 端点违反零留存合同，留存了数据，部分无法归属用户的 Notion AI 对话可能暴露。两方表述都不能独立验证对方事件的全部范围。

text.en: Fireworks updated its security bulletin on November 17, separating August–October and late-October intrusions and saying account and billing data for all accounts opened before October 30 was accessed.
text.zhHans: Fireworks 于 11 月 17 日更新安全通报，将八月至十月初与十月下旬的入侵区分为两起，并称 10 月 30 日前创建的所有账户的账户及账单资料被访问。

claims.notes: Fireworks Nov17 update is a later disclosure than its Nov9 interim bulletin; this is the company account, not independent forensics.

text.en: Notion says data was retained from the Fireworks endpoints it used despite a zero-retention commitment, and some unattributable Notion AI chats may have been exposed.
text.zhHans: Notion 称，其使用的 Fireworks 端点违反零留存承诺而留存数据，部分无法归属用户的 Notion AI 对话可能暴露。

claims.notes: Notion original describes its own affected integration; does not independently confirm all Fireworks-wide incident findings.
